description: Build and sign a mutual-auth certificate identifying an agent or information system. Returns the signed MutualAuthCertificate object ready to carry into a handshake. The issuer's Ed25519 private key (hex) signs over the canonical (JCS) form.

binding.description: For an agent: the APS agent_id. For an IS: the resource domain (e.g., mcp://api.bank.com)

issuer_privkey_hex.description: Ed25519 private key (hex) of the issuer — used to sign

issuer_pubkey_hex.description: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the issuer

role.description: Role of the subject this cert identifies

subject_id.description: Stable subject identifier (e.g., agent DID, IS endpoint URL)

subject_pubkey_hex.description: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the subject

name: mutualAuthBuildCertificate
